paragraphs: The testing methodology was formulated to validate system accuracy, state machine transitions, and visual indicators across three distinct environmental operating conditions: completely dry air, calibrated optimal damp soil, and liquid water saturation.

Each test condition evaluated the raw 12-bit ADC measurement, calculated moisture percentage, reported operational state on the OLED display, status of the PC13 alert LED, and serial telemetry output at 115200 baud.
